At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.

Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

At Roche, we believe precision medicine radically improves lives. Our Global CAP/CLIA laboratories are the "heartbeat" of diagnostic innovation, bridging the gap between early research and life-saving commercial diagnostics. As a Laboratory Manager, you aren't just overseeing a facility; you are leading a team that transforms complex biological data into the insights clinicians need to treat patients with cancer and other life-altering diseases.

We are seeking a high-caliber Laboratory Manager (m/f/d) to oversee our dual-specialty pathology and immunoassay laboratory. This role requires a unique blend of technical expertise in tissue-based diagnostics and immunoassay automated testing.

You will be responsible for the operational excellence of the lab, ensuring that both the Histology/Pathology and Immunoassay/Chemistry departments function at peak efficiency while maintaining total compliance with ISO15189, CAP (College of American Pathologists) and CLIA regulations.

The Opportunity

You will oversee a dual-specialty laboratory at the forefront of the industry. Your leadership will span two critical domains:
* Anatomic Pathology: Managing high-complexity tissue-based diagnostics, including advanced Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and In Situ Hybridization (ISH)
* Immunoassay Excellence: Driving peaks of operational efficiency in our automated immunoassay tracks on state-of-the-art cobas® platforms

You will also be a key driver in our Digital Pathology transformation, integrating whole-slide imaging and AI-based image analysis into routine clinical workflows to set new standards for diagnostic precision. Your key responsibilities:

* Visionary Operational Leadership: Supervise the daily "rhythm" of the lab, synchronizing pathology and immunoassay workflows to ensure competitive turnaround times (TAT)
* Guardian of Quality: Maintain an "inspection-ready" culture, serving as the primary lead for CAP/CLIA and ISO 15189 audits
* Champion of People: Lead, mentor, and inspire team of Laboratory scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence
* Strategic Technical Oversight: Manage the validation and implementation of new assays and novel platforms, ensuring every piece of equipment is a high-performing component of our diagnostic system
* Innovate & Improve: Actively identify opportunities for workflow optimization and cost-effective management without ever compromising the quality that defines the Roche name

Who you are
* You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Clinical Laboratory Science, Medical Technology, or a related Biological Science. A Master’s (MHA/MBA) or PhD is highly preferred.
* Furthermore, you have 5+ years of experience in a clinical laboratory setting
* Proven expertise in both anatomic pathology and automated immunoassay workflows is a distinct advantage
* The ideal candidate isn't just a technical expert; You are a leader who fosters a culture of quality, safety, and continuous improvement with at least 2 years of experience in a leadership role
* You live the Roche mindset by maintaining a track record of zero-deficiency inspections and a passion for navigating the complexities of emerging global regulations

Your Application 

Please submit your updated CV. References and certificates are not required at this stage. Please apply with English application documents. 

Please note that no additional documents can be submitted after your application has been sent.

We look forward to receiving your application and potentially welcoming you to our team!

 

 

Your contact to us! With people. For people.

Do you need further support?

Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Your creative fieldWe are looking for a full-time, permanent ORM / Social Media Manager to start as soon as possible. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich).

As our new ORM / Social Media Manager , you will be the person who makes Contabo's shift from an affordable VPS provider to a reliable, AI ready, developer friendly infrastructure brand real, in the exact communities where developers, DevOps engineers, and AI practitioners actually talk. You build that credibility from the ground up, combining daily community intelligence with real commercial content production.

Every day, you monitor selected online platforms like Reddit or Discord, triaging brand mentions for further action. You also engage proactively wherever technical conversations happen, from tutorials and GPU workload guides to infrastructure tips and genuine participation in technical discussions, always credibility first and aligned with our tone of voice.

Alongside that, you plan and produce our commercial and marketing content, including product launch announcements, promotional posts, competitor positioning, Contabo Black go-to-market content, event content, and repurposed community threads, all planned in a rolling content calendar, in collaboration with other functions in Marketing. You also write and maintain community intervention playbooks, so the whole team knows how to respond before a situation escalates.

On top of the day to day, you get to build our internal advocacy programme from scratch: you identify technically fluent colleagues across Product and Engineering, bring them on board with clear guidelines, and keep them engaged over time, working toward a team of active online and offline advocates.

You report directly to our Head of Creative Marketing, and the monthly picture you build of sentiment, Share of Voice, and platform activity feeds straight into product and marketing decisions, with real visibility all the way up to our CMO. At its core, this role lives at the intersection of protecting our reputation and driving commercial content forward: someone who speaks the language of developers, but thinks like a marketer.

What convinces us Your personality, paired with:
• 5 to 7 years of experience in community management, ORM, social media, or content marketing, ideally with some background in producing commercial or marketing content
• Hands-on experience with ORM or social listening platforms (Brandwatch, Mention, Sprinklr, Peec.ai, or similar), and confidence running sentiment analysis and Share of Voice reporting
• Strong social media content creation skills across platform native formats, from Reddit and Discord to LinkedIn and X, paired with real commercial and marketing content production experience such as product marketing copy, promotional posts, and competitor positioning
• Genuine community management and engagement experience with a developer or tech focused audience, and the analytical ability to turn what you see there into decisions
• Strong communication and conflict handling skills, clear goal and result orientation, and the ability to build and grow a network without formal authority
• A proactive, ownership driven mindset: you handle pressure well, stay customer oriented, and hold yourself to a high-performance bar
• An authentic community voice who shows up as a real person rather than a brand account, thinks commercially about when community presence drives business outcomes, and stays composed under public criticism without escalating situations
• AI fluency beyond basic prompting skills

Should have:
• Experience coordinating events or conferences, and managing an ORM agency or similar external vendor relationship
• Strong strategic thinking, genuine team spirit, and openness to change as the role and priorities evolve
• A natural sense of ownership that extends beyond your core tasks
• Real curiosity about the cloud, hosting, and developer ecosystem, and a habit of following those communities on your own
• Industry experience in cloud infrastructure, hosting, SaaS, or developer tools, ideally with a B2B tech marketing background
• Great Reddit karma

Nice to have:
• Spanish or Portuguese for LATAM coverage, and German language skills, are a plus alongside fluent English (C1+)
• ORM or social listening platform certifications, Google Analytics, or AI, SEO, and GAIO monitoring credentials
• A degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or a related field, though equivalent practical experience with a solid technical understanding works just as well

We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference.

Awesome ProspectsAt Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.

jobs.occupation: Master's Thesis: Multi-Fidelity Propeller Optimization (all genders) (Ingenieur/in - Medizintechnik)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLEWe are looking for a Master's student to join our growing Aerodynamics team and carry out a thesis project on the development of a multi-fidelity propeller optimization framework for our hybrid-electric eVTOL aircraft. You will help extend an existing automated propeller design workflow - covering geometry generation, meshing, CFD simulation and post-processing - into a full optimization environment that combines fast Blade Element Momentum Theory (BEMT) predictions, high-fidelity CFD, and aeroacoustics prediction.
Your thesis will directly support propeller designs that perform efficiently across hover, transition and forward flight. The thesis takes around six months and is supervised jointly by our Aerodynamics team and the Chair of Aerodynamics and Fluid Mechanics at the Technical University of Munich (TUM).
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Conduct a literature review on propeller optimization methodologies and multi-fidelity approaches
• Familiarize yourself with two existing frameworks for propeller design optimization: low-fidelity BEMT environment, automated CFD surrogate modeling-based optimization framework
• Integrate aeroacoustics prediction methods, in the form of PSU-WOPWOP, as part of the low-fidelity BEMT framework
• Develop methods and strategies to leverage both frameworks and incorporate them into a combined multi-fidelity optimization framework
• Revise and update the automated geometry generation, CFD simulation execution, and post-processing into a unified workflow
• In the process you will parametrize the propeller design and perform an optimization of a test case eVTOL propeller, generate the pareto-front between efficiency and noise
• Validate low-fidelity predictions against CFD reference solutions
• Conduct optimization studies for representative flight conditions, evaluating solution quality, computational cost and convergence
• Optionally: utilize surrogate models to incorporate feedback from high fidelity model to low fidelity model for improved optimization convergence and acceleration
• Document your methodology and findings in your final thesis report

WHAT YOU BRING
• Are a student of mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, physics or a comparable field, enrolled at TUM and working towards your Master's degree
• Bring familiarity with CAD and CFD software, ideally Siemens NX and Ansys Fluent
• Hold foundational knowledge of aircraft and propulsion aerodynamics
• Have basic knowledge of numerical methods and optimization techniques
• Have strong Python programming skills
• Are able to work independently and collaborate with a team
• Have good written and verbal communication skills in English
• Bring an interest in aeroacoustics and propeller noise prediction

Moreover, it would be helpful if you also
• have prior exposure to Blade Element Momentum Theory or other low-fidelity aerodynamic methods
• have experience with aeroacoustics prediction methods like PSU-WOPWOP
• have experience with HPC-based simulation workflows
• explore the use of surrogate models to accelerate convergence between fidelity levels

WHAT WE OFFER
• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides
• A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn
• Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation
• Health & wellbeing: subsidized lunch in our canteen
• Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on board

jobs.occupation: Product Manager Protection Relays (f/m/d) – Portfolio Positioning (Produktmanager/in)
jobs.description:
As a passionate and innovation-driven organization, Siemens Electrification & Automation's Growth Protection team shapes the future of electrical power systems.The Product Manager (f/m/d) – Portfolio Positioning for Protection Relays translates portfolio strategy and product innovations into clear customer value, differentiated positioning, and compelling narratives for successful market adoption. This role acts as a key interface between Product Management and Marketing, aligning product direction, market priorities, and customer needs to ensure a consistent and differentiated market presence. What we offer you

- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests- A work environment where you can contribute with your whole personality and truly feel like part of Siemens

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

You'll make an impact by

- Translating the SIPROTEC and Reyrolle portfolio strategy into clear customer value propositions, differentiated positioning, and messaging foundations that drive portfolio growth and market success.- Serving as the primary interface between Product Management and Marketing, ensuring alignment between portfolio strategy, commercialization priorities, and market-facing positioning.- Taking responsibility for the successful market introduction of new products and portfolio innovations by defining customer value propositions, differentiation strategies, commercialization approaches, and launch readiness requirements.- Leading the portfolio positioning workstream within cross-functional go-to-market initiatives and driving alignment across Product Management, Market Development, Marketing, and Sales organizations.- Owning and continuously evolving portfolio narratives, customer-value propositions, and competitive positioning based on market insights, customer feedback, and input from Sales, Market Development, and Technical Application teams.- Providing strategic recommendations for portfolio positioning and commercialization decisions to support business growth, market differentiation, and long-term portfolio success.

You excel in

- You hold a university degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, Automation Technology, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a comparable educational background.- Several years of experience supporting portfolio commercialization, portfolio positioning, product launches, and value proposition development in Product Management, Portfolio Management, Portfolio Positioning, Market Development, Business Development, technical-commercial strategy, or related commercial functions.- Strong understanding of electrical protection equipment, automation, power systems, substations, or related customer applications.- Proven ability to translate technical product capabilities into compelling customer value propositions, differentiation strategies, and commercial messaging.- Experience leading cross-functional collaboration between Product Management, Marketing, Sales, and Engineering.- Very good command of English (business and negotiation level). Additional language skills are a plus. German language skills are advantageous.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
